invariants: Every project-scoped work, asset, screen, reference, benchmark, component, and system record must resolve to exactly one Project relation before it can be treated as project canon.
Project pages expose only Project-filtered linked views; unfiltered master views belong under the system-master area.
Project Registry is an AI/System identity master and must not be used as the default human Project Home.
Human Project Home must not expose raw AI/System metadata as default human-facing content.
A Human Project Home remains self-contained and directly exposes the full game or story flow, core systems and necessary setting, and project-specific core data tables.
Same-record AI writes compare Revision and Last Edited immediately before a bounded record-level update; a stale read aborts instead of overwriting newer human or agent changes.
A successful Notion write requires destination readback before completion may be reported.

Notion is the primary human-facing canon for project overview, visual direction, visual asset catalogs, budget tables, tier tables, core-system human models, human-editable flow maps, and storyboards.
Repository runtime code, scenes, resources, runtime data, builds, tests, and runtime evidence remain implementation truth for their domains.

Base governance, Skills, Guides, Templates, Registry/generated governance, Base validation contracts, CI policy, planning documents, and Notion work are GPT-owned non-product work even when some files use a programming language.
Codex is not the general repository executor. Codex enters by default only when an actual game-project Godot product implementation task exists.

GPT owns planning, research synthesis, adversarial review, Base/Notion governance, implementation specification, image generation or editing, approved-visual delivery, and final implementation review.
Codex owns actual game-project Godot product implementation: GDScript/product code, Scene/Resource/runtime wiring, runtime data integration, build/export, and implementation/runtime/play tests.
A Notion or planning change is not a Codex trigger by itself. It becomes a Codex handoff only when the approved change requires actual Godot product implementation.
Codex must rehydrate the current project GitHub and relevant Notion canon before Godot product mutation.
Codex must not generate or generatively edit project images and may consume only visuals approved for current use and attached/uploaded in Notion with readback.
If a required visual is missing, Codex returns GPT_VISUAL_REQUEST; GPT creates or edits the visual and Notion approval plus upload/readback precedes Codex consumption.
The retired GPT to PowerShell to local Codex bootstrap path must not be reintroduced as the default workflow.
Project Home is self-contained for core human understanding; child pages are drilldown/evidence, not a substitute for the Home explanation.
